title: presidio-hardened/evidence-ref@2
description: Cross-repo signed evidence contract, assurance-tier revision (ADR-0003). Frozen with the same discipline as @1 (ADR-0001 D5): no field removals, no type or constraint changes, no new required fields within @2. Differs from @1 in exactly two ways: the envelope 'schema' field is REQUIRED and must be this id (no grandfathering in @2), and each evidenceRef MAY carry an optional 'assurance_tier'. assurance_tier declares the runtime-compliance assurance regime of the referenced evidence (Computational Jurisprudence, Stantchev 2026): 'attested' = trusted-execution / signature-attested (the implicit @1 tier, and the default when the field is absent); 'optimistic' = a bonded assertion presumed valid unless a fraud proof lands in a dispute window; 'zk' = a succinct zero-knowledge proof of the norm predicate. The detached signature is unchanged from @1: alg(canonical_json({"content_hash": ..., "signer": ...})) where canonical_json sorts keys, uses (",", ":") separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False; assurance_tier is signed only insofar as a producer content-hashes it into the referenced payload.

schema.description: Required in @2 (no grandfathering); must match exactly. Verifiers reject any other value (fail-closed).

assuranceTier.description: Assurance regime of the referenced evidence. Optional; the default when absent is 'attested', matching every @1 record.

evidenceRef.description: One signed evidence reference. The 8 @1 fields are required, non-empty strings <=512 chars, no null bytes; item_id domain validation is consumer-side. 'assurance_tier' is the single additive optional field in @2; when absent it means 'attested'.
